mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.intro: Ask for a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
mfa.unavailable: Not available on this server yet: its encryption key has not been configured.
mfa.loadFailed: Could not load the two-step sign-in status.
mfa.step1: 1. Add this key to your authenticator app
mfa.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
mfa.badCode: That code was not accepted. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
mfa.recoveryHelp: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
mfa.turnOffHelp: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code, to turn two-step sign-in off.
mfa.newCodesHelp: Enter a code from your app. Your current recovery codes will stop working.
mfa.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
mfa.enforcedOff: Not required at sign-in yet. Require it once you have saved your recovery codes.
mfa.enforceHelp: Prove both work before a code becomes required: a current code from your app and one of your recovery codes. That recovery code is then used up.
mfa.unenforceHelp: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code, to stop requiring a code at sign-in.
mfa.needCodes: Issue new recovery codes first — at least two are needed to require a code at sign-in.
mfa.enforcedNow: A code is now required at every sign-in.
mfa.unenforcedNow: A code is no longer required at sign-in.
mfa.required: Two-step sign-in is required for administrator accounts and cannot be turned off.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.sub: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.empty: Enter the code from your app or a recovery code.
mfa.badCode: That code was not accepted. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
mfa.expired: Your sign-in expired. Enter your password again.
mfa.unavailable: Two-step sign-in is unavailable on the server right now. Try again later.
mfa.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
mfaSetup.sub: Administrator accounts must use two-step sign-in. Add Familista to your authenticator app and save your recovery codes, then sign in again.
